title: Radio group
summary: One choice from a few options, as radios or as a segmented bar. The options are its own option children; the radios are native inputs, so arrow keys and grouping are the browser's.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value; what the form submits.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

props.name: description
props.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

props.name: required
props.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

props.name: variant
props.description: radio draws a list of radios; segmented draws one bar of segments.

props.name: direction
props.description: Radio variant: stacked or in a wrapping row.

props.name: fill
props.description: Segmented variant: spread the segments across the full width.

events.name: input
events.description: The value changed (native, composed: bubbles out of the shadow root). Read event.target.value.

events.name: change
events.description: The user committed the value (re-dispatched from the inner control, composed).

events.name: pk-value-change
events.description: The user changed the value (same moment as change; carries it).

methods.name: focus()
methods.description: Focuses the chosen radio, or the first enabled one.

a11y: role=radiogroup named by label; each option is a native radio in one tab stop with arrow-key movement; the segmented variant hides the radio visually but keeps it focusable and shows the focus ring on the segment. Options are 44px tall on a phone.

examples.title: Radios
examples.html: <pk-radio-group label="Condition" value="nm"><option value="nm">Near mint</option><option value="vf">Very fine</option><option value="g" disabled>Graded (unavailable)</option></pk-radio-group>

examples.title: Segmented
examples.html:
<pk-radio-group variant="segmented" label="View" value="week"><option value="day">Day</option><option value="week">Week</option><option value="month">Month</option></pk-radio-group>
<pk-radio-group variant="segmented" fill label="Channel" value="all"><option value="all">All</option><option value="web">Web</option><option value="market">Market</option></pk-radio-group>
